title: Development and validation of a novel stem cell subtype for bladder cancer based on stem genomic profiling.
summary: Supervised/unsupervised ML on six genomic datasets and 26 stem-cell gene sets yielded three bladder-cancer stem-enrichment subtypes, with cross-platform stability and distinct prognosis/immune/therapy associations. Predicted treatment sensitivities remain computational, not clinical response evidence. Organization is unavailable in the deposited bibliographic metadata.
